name: band 45 degrees biceps curl
description: A band curl with your arms angled about 45 degrees behind your body, which stretches the biceps and works the long head.
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the ends, then set your arms about 45 degrees behind your torso.
Keep your chest up and shoulders back.
Curl your hands up while your upper arms stay in that angled position.
Squeeze at the top and lower slowly.
Avoid leaning back to finish the rep.
